scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,worker,web -c blue,magenta,green "pnpm dev:api" "pnpm dev:worker" "pnpm dev:web"
scripts.generate:api: uv run --project apps/api python apps/api/scripts/export_openapi.py && pnpm --dir apps/web generate:api
scripts.eval:fake: uv run --project apps/api python -m sourcetrace.evaluation.cli fake --dataset evals/fixtures/dataset-v1.json --observations evals/fixtures/observations-v1.json --metadata evals/fixtures/metadata-v1.json --output output/evals/fixture-report.json
scripts.eval:real: uv run --project apps/api python -m sourcetrace.evaluation.cli real
scripts.eval:review: uv run --project apps/api python -m sourcetrace.evaluation.cli review
scripts.format: uv run --project apps/api ruff format apps/api && pnpm --dir apps/web format
scripts.check: uv run --project apps/api ruff check apps/api && uv run --project apps/api mypy apps/api/src && pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck
